confidence_rationale: Canonical review by the lab that defined reality filtering; the phenomenon (preconscious OFC/reward tagging of whether an evoked memory pertains to now and can be acted on; failure -> confabulation) is exactly the provenance-guard requirement MECH-487 must satisfy. Confidence held below 0.8 because it maps the GUARD requirement, not a retention BUFFER, and the mapping is human-clinical to computational.
failure_signatures: A retention store for rejected/imagined alternatives that lacks a distinct 'does-this-pertain-to-present-reality' tag reproduces the confabulation failure mode: retained-but-never-executed content is treated as actionable/real.
The guard is preconscious and fast (200-300 ms frontal positivity); a provenance check bolted on only at readout, after retained content has already entered valuation, is the wrong architecture.

mapping.source_claim_statement: The orbitofrontal cortex, with reward-system structures, runs a phylogenetically old preconscious 'reality filter' (an extinction-based faculty) that determines whether an evoked memory refers to ongoing reality and can be acted upon; its failure produces confabulation and disorientation.
mapping.ree_translation: Any MECH-487 mechanism that retains rejected/uncommitted E3 candidate trajectories past the current tick must carry a provenance/reality tag (REE's MECH-094 committed_vs_imagined register) that keeps retained content marked as considered-but-not-real, so it is never read as committed experience by residue/valence/hippocampal write paths. This is the biological warrant for making Leg-3 retention a METACOGNITIVE (source-tagged) mechanism rather than bare memory, and for following the MECH-322 bounded/audited template instead of relaxing MECH-094.
mapping.mapping_caveat: Human lesion/ERP evidence about a filter over evoked memories, not about a computational buffer that stores which unchosen alternative existed. It establishes that a dedicated provenance filter is architecturally necessary; it does not specify the retention buffer's form.
mapping.source_context: Human clinical neuropsychology (confabulating/disoriented patients) plus healthy-subject continuous-recognition ERP paradigms; orbitofrontal cortex and reward system.

confidence_components.notes: Authoritative review, strong construct. Mapping_fidelity high for the guard requirement, lower as a model of the retention store itself; transfer_risk moderate (clinical human -> REE substrate).
